messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call — org 'Polestar Health' (org_id=org-842) is triggering emergency org limiter. High 429/503 rate and queueing on inference workers. Auto-surge protection engaged.
devon: I'm on it, looking at ingress and worker queues now.
sara: Quick mitigation proposal: temporary per-org QPS bump + disable nonessential features (aux-rerank) for that org. Hard timer 20m, then staged rollback.
leo: Agree, set a conservative hard cap and flag billing. If errors persist, route some traffic to fallback model variant.
ops-bot: Executing: ```infra-cli org-adjust-rate --org org-842 --qps 1200 --duration 20m --reason "emergency spike: org-842"```
ops-bot: Done — soft limit updated, gateway-rule gw-9c8 applied to org-842.
maria: Noted. CS alerted customer contact (pd@polestarhealth.com) and asked them to pause bulk backfill jobs. :email:
devon: 1 minute after bump: 429s down ~70%, p95 latency improving. Capturing traces: run_id=run-2026-03-17-0843.
sara: Also toggling feature flag to reduce load: ```ffctl set aux-rerank org-842 off --reason "emergency mitigation"```
ops-bot: Feature flag change propagated to edge nodes.
leo: Still seeing some tail latency on long-context requests; prepare fallback routing to gpt-medium-quant if it spikes again.
maria: CS will draft an incident note and open a support ticket with the customer; copying operations steps in ticket.
devon: tagging billing for unexpected QPS delta so finance is aware.
sara: Rollout plan: keep 1200 QPS for 20m, step down to 1.5x baseline for 30m, then full rollback if stable. I'll coordinate the stepdown and rollback.
ops-bot: Scheduling automated rollback checks at epoch 3839877750; will rollback if thresholds met. :white_check_mark:
leo: After rollback, run a smoke test and then start RCA. Assigning postmortem to @sara, @devon, @maria.
sara: Artifacts: logs https://internal.redwood/logs?run=run-2026-03-17-0843, ingress dashboard https://dashboards.redwood/ingress/org-842, runbook https://runbooks.redwood/mitigate-org-spike
devon: Manual command if needed: ```curl -X POST https://infra.redwood/api/orgs/842/rate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"qps":1200,"duration":"20m"}'```
maria: Thanks everyone — keeping updates here and will post customer-facing summary once we confirm stability. :pray:
